docs.purpose: Lets an admin retry cancelling a deleted user's subscription when the automatic cancellation failed at delete time, so the person does not keep getting billed after their account was removed.
docs.data_story: It reads 1 table — `user_profiles` and writes `user_profiles` and `admin_audit_log`. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. It is called from 1 place: `admin_user_detail`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `MUTATION`. It declares `database.writes[]` with a `write_discipline` per target (the Spec 122 vocabulary verbatim), its idempotency posture, its optimistic contract and its rollback. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: Refuses (400) when there is no outstanding cancel-failure marker. Safety gate: if the account was reactivated since (account_deleted_at is NULL) it treats the marker as stale debt and clears it WITHOUT calling Stripe, to avoid cancelling a live paying subscription. admin_key auth is forbidden. Marker-clear plus audit row always commit atomically; the Stripe network call is outside the transaction and on failure the marker is deliberately left set, never a false success. Also cites 20_stripe_web_checkout.md. Called via a template-literal base in SubscriptionOps.tsx. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: EXTERNAL SERVICE CALLS: Stripe only — cancelAllStripeSubscriptions(profile.stripe_customer_id) at :130, which calls getStripeClient (src/lib/stripe/client.ts:153, throws StripeNotConfiguredError at :25) then stripe.subscriptions.list at src/lib/stripe/client.ts:154 and stripe.subscriptions.update({cancel_at_period_end:true}) at src/lib/stripe/client.ts:159. No Supabase/Firebase call. No PostHog track() — this state-mutating admin route emits no analytics event (same gap as reconcile). CENSUS CHECK: census_reads [user_profiles] and census_writes [user_profiles, admin_audit_log] confirmed; census missed the `profiles` admin-auth read and the MFA-gated admin_backup_codes. No SELECT *. All SQL parameterised. Marker-clear + audit are correctly atomic (withTransaction at :92) and the Stripe call is outside the txn (:130 before :142). Idempotency note: cancelAllStripeSubscriptions is documented and coded as idempotent (skips terminal and already-cancel_at_period_end subs, src/lib/stripe/client.ts:157-158), so a replayed retry is safe but writes a second audit row. | Caching: none observed — no Cache-Control/revalidate/dynamic export in the file | Other guards / classification: Refuses authMethod==='admin_key' at :36-44 (403). Target-is-admin refused at :72-74 via isProfileAdmin (src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:196). Debt precondition: refuses when stripe_cancel_failed_at IS NULL at :83-85 (400). Reactivation gate: if account_deleted_at IS NULL the marker is cleared WITHOUT any Stripe call at :116-119. CSRF Origin allowlist at src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:70-78. MFA gate INERT unless ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED (:143). | Locking tests: src/tests/admin-subscription-ops.infra.test.ts.
